visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short dark hair and a cream-colored t-shirt stands outside a traditional wooden building with a tiled roof. He looks toward the camera with a cheerful, slightly mischievous expression, gesturing with his hands as if explaining a plan. Bright natural daylight illuminates the scene. (2) The scene shifts to an interior space where the male stands behind a table laden with various packaged snacks. Behind him, a sign reads 'DODO MEN'. He presents a dark grey mug containing a dark liquid. Digital heart icons and bubbles appear around him as he clasps his hands near his chest. (3) The male is seen running along an outdoor street lined with grey brick walls and lush green trees. He holds the camera in a selfie perspective, looking back over his shoulder with a strained but excited smile. (4) The male stands in front of a modern storefront with glass windows and 'EBEN' branding. He is now wearing dark sunglasses. He points enthusiastically at the store sign and the menu board inside. (5) Close-up shots of yellow cups filled with scoops of multi-colored gelato. A wooden spoon is embedded in one. The male is seen tasting the gelato with a look of extreme satisfaction, nodding at the camera. (6) The male sits on a small yellow stool in front of a pink wall decorated with 'I WEAR KOMBUCHA' posters. He holds a pink cup and continues to speak directly to the camera with a confident posture.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male with dark styled hair wearing a light cream-colored t-shirt with 'I WEAR KOMBUCHA' text and a dark wristwatch. He wears dark sunglasses in the latter half of the video.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Traditional wooden architecture, a studio/office space with 'DODO MEN' branding and shelves of food, an urban street with brick walls, and a modern 'EBEN' pop-up store interior with menu boards, counters, and promotional posters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice greeting the audience. The background music is a bouncy, high-tempo electronic pop track. A soft 'pop' sound effect occurs when heart graphics appear on the screen. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect transitions the scene to the interior. The male speaker's voice is slightly muffled but clear, maintaining a playful and sweet tone. (3) As the scene changes to the outdoor run, the male speaker's breathing becomes audible, indicating physical exertion. A female voice (off-screen) is heard complaining with a breathless, high-pitched tone, creating a humorous contrast. (4) A whimsical 'sparkle' chime occurs when the male introduces the gelato store. The BGM increases slightly in volume, and the speaker's tone becomes more promotional and persuasive. (5) Fast-paced talking continues as the speaker describes the flavors. Occasional 'thud' sound effects match the visual of gelato being scooped. (6) The video concludes with a dramatic cartoon-style 'shock' sound effect following a final question from the off-screen female voice, punctuating the comedic ending.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Resolution -> Product Showcase -> CTA -> Kicker
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the EBEN Kombucha pop-up store at Eslite Spectrum Nanxi. The video uses a comedic 'boyfriend' POV narrative to engage viewers, presenting the store as a perfect date destination with unique kombucha floats and gelato flavors.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the 'EBEN' brand, store location, business hours, and promotion of specific menu items.
